title: May 05, 2026
summary: KFAR SAVA, Israel, May 5, 2026 - Silicom Ltd. (NASDAQ: SILC), a leading provider of networking and data infrastructure solutions, today announced that one of the AI infrastructure challengers has selected its high-performance, inference-specific solution for deployment as part of its Proof of Concept (PoC) efforts targeting mainly Tier-1 hyperscalers. The PoC is scheduled for the second half of 2026. To support this, the customer has placed initial orders for delivery in the first half of 2026. Upon successful completion of the PoC, the customer anticipates transitioning to an initial full-scale deployment requiring tens of thousands of Silicom units, each carrying a multi-thousand-dollar Average Selling Price (ASP).
